title: read_kb resolves bare filename by recursive search (Vault/Cowork miss-routing)
description: Owner asked agent to read weather.txt (in KB folder on his PC). Agent picked read_cowork (only action promising bare-name match) -> 'cowork: no file matching weather.txt in last 14 days'. read_kb needs exact relpath; read_note is .md-only. Fix: folderread.Read falls back to recursive case-insensitive basename search over KB folder (superset of Vault+Cowork), newest wins; clearer miss error; steer prompt to use read_kb for arbitrary named files.
close_reason: folderread.Read falls back to recursive case-insensitive basename search (newest wins, dotdirs+symlinks skipped) when a bare name misses at root; clearer miss error; prompt steers bare-name reads to read_kb. Tests green, build clean.

title: Dispatch bot falsely claims WhatsApp sent when no contact / ambiguous match
description: Root cause: execute() returns no-contact and ambiguous-match as a nil-error STATUS (send did not happen). Run()'s send_whatsapp branch discards that status and keeps the model's pre-written 'Sent to X'. Regression from the duplicate-status fix (564bc19). Fix: send_whatsapp returns empty status on real send (model confirmation stands), truthful status on not-sent (overrides model), 'Send failed' on transport error; add global EVIDENCE rule to dispatchSystemPrompt.
close_reason: Fixed: send_whatsapp now reports the real delivery outcome; truthful status overrides optimistic model text; EVIDENCE rule added to prompt. TDD: 4 new tests + existing send tests green; full suite passes.
